full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff, initially, sought for declaration of his title to and recovery of khas possession against the defendant in respect of 0.01-1/4 acres of land, equivalent to 512 square feet, from the extreme western portion of suit plot No. 110 out of his purchased land of 0.08-1/4 acres, purchased on 24-3-64 from Hazi Moran Ali Bepari by a registered kabala, It is alleged, inter alia, that the defendant is an unauthorised and illegal possessor of a portion of plot No.936 adjacent west of suit plot No.110, that in the month of February 1972 the defendant forcibly encroached upon the western part of the suit plot by constructing a semi pucca building thereon and he again on 20-9-81 encroached further area by extending the said semi pucca building. In the plaint the plaintiff described the suit land to be 512 square feet equivalent to 0.01-1/4 acres by annexing a sketch map.
